data.text:
John, I’m in—I’ll select **10 tons this month**. My family made its living on this lake, and I want the village to be able to rely on it for years, not just enjoy one good catch.

Luke, your offer to take nothing is generous, but there’s room for you to earn an equal share while we leave enough fish to refill the lake. I support the half-stock limit, split equally, with everyone checking the catches afterward. Emma, would you join us at 10 tons?
